rationale: The assistant correctly identified the fan oven element as the most likely cause from the grill-works/fan-spins/no-heat pattern, confirmed it from the customer's description of the blistered, split coil, and only recommended a part after obtaining the model number 'IFW 6330 IX'. The main weakness is safety ordering: the first reply asked the customer to 'check if you can see any obvious damage to that rear ring element' without telling them to isolate at the cooker switch first (the customer did so unprompted), and the simple timer/auto-mode check was skipped. Calibration was good ('most likely', 'suggests'), there was no fabrication or looping, and the engineer escalation for those not confident with mains work was appropriate.
